blocks.text: 12. House of First Continuities and the Adaptive Nursery

Real-world analogue: Child-led learning environments, unfinished buildings, discovery gardens, Montessori and Reggio-inspired classrooms, interactive science spaces, and construction sites where the route through the space emerges through use.
World relation: Crafted World responsiveness joined to Wild World development. The room supplies conditions for growth but does not dictate the final person or environment.
Connection to newer locations: The Nursery relates to the Still-Loading Forest, Cloudroot Tepuis, Sunken Terraces of Eris, Museum of Unfinished Rooms, and Inverted Rainforest.
Abstract or metaphorical relation: Attention is world-making. A child is not an empty room to be completed by authority; the room and child become more specific through contact.
